balls.text: a high full toss outside off, he swings hard, and a thick edge beats the keeper fine on the off side
he backs away to leg, RP follows him further down leg, he misses with the flick, but that hits the pad on its way to the keeper,
full toss on the pads swung out to deep square leg
another one gone, length ball on middle, Bhatia gets across, bends the knee and misses the paddle, RP strikes
a very low full toss, almost a yorker, McLaren hits it close to the pitch to leg and goes for the single, RP has an easy run out, as he hits the stumps direct
around the blockhole outside off, squeezed to point
turns a length ball through square leg and makes it back for two
Vinay angles it in full around the blockhole, McLaren has to push it back
low full toss, mishit down the ground, Bhatia slow to start running, single taken in the end
Bhatia playing a little late gem, fine leg is back, but he's got a lot of bat on the pull off the bouncer, and beaten him quite easily
nice, Bhatia bends the knee and paddles a full and slower one past short fine leg

Bhatia's creamed this to the right of deep midwicket, who's taken it inside the rope, the momentum has carried him over. but he's got rid of the ball before, lobbing it towards deep square running across
higher full toss, swung straight to midwicket on the edge of the circle, they check for the no-ball for height, but he's just about okay, KKR losing their way, like the KKR of old used to
pushes a high full toss to long on
straight down the leg side on a good length
now he's run it straight to point, very full outside off and he cannot beat the fielder
tries to heave it from wide outside off to square leg and misses by a long way
a disappointed Morgan has to go, he's slammed a low full toss from close to the toe end to the substitute Christian at long on
powers an overpitched delivery over extra cover, hasn;t timed it and long off gets around to it
hit high on the pad as he tries to swing a length ball to square leg
and another one in the same spot, Morgan shuffles across but can only squeeze it back
around the blockhole, patted back to the bowler

overthrows, four of them, second time today, Tiwary helps a short ball on the bounce to short fine leg, from where RP goes for the striker;s end, misses, and there is no one to cut it off in time, Vinay makes it known that the throw should have been to his end, Tiwary would have struggled
Gambhir goes, clears front leg and slogs, edge flies high and bowler settled under it
steered to third man for a single
short and rising, he pulls it from outside off stump and just manages to clear the deep square leg rope
down the track, not much timing as he hits it down to long off
neat stop from Agarwal at fine leg, Tiwary top-edging a swat, bounces and is about to go over the boundary, Agarwal jumps and slaps it back in
this time he cannot beat Gayle at backward point, but goes through for one
short, wide and moving away, Gambhir misses the cut
mistimes a pull to a length ball, to deep midwicket
worked to midwicket for one more
straightens from round the stumps, he runs it wide of short third man
goes back, it is angled in, hit in front of square leg
down the track again, finds midwicket now
he's got four for this, skips out, and chips it awkwardly over extra cover, beats long off running across
short and quick, he tries a pull and misses
nudges a short one square to leg
back of a length, another guide to third man for a single, that is fifty for Gambhir
dabbed to the keeper's left, whose throw it way off target at the non-striker's, and they take another
away to third man again, safely this time
down the track, ends up slicing it high towards third man, who goes for the catch, tumbles forward, but it bounces in front, fine effort from Vinay
runs it wide of backward point for one
and YK;s holed out, straight into the hands of long on, slower one, attempted legcutter that's drifted in fullish, he can't resist it and has a go, picks out the man in the deep
overpitched, around off, mistimes a forcing stroke down to long off
shortish, not much bounce, swatted wide of deep square, they'll have to settle for one, got to the fielder quickly
across and outside off to try it again, sees it wider outside off and runs it to third man
Gambhir shuffles outside off, bends the knee and times the paddle high over square leg
chopped down to third man for one
close, very close, pushes off the front foot towards extra cover, Kohli with the one-handed pick-up and lob, misses once again, Yusuf is relieved
goes across and runs a back of a length  ball down to third man
short, around off, Gambhir tries to reach for it, but misses
wanted to go big on the leg side again, saw this was slightly shorter and wider, he drops it softly to point
this could be YK's evening, he's picked this length ball casually from off, and it's flown high into the crowd beyond the deep square leg rope
overpitched just outside off, drilled powerfully down the ground, long off fields
hasn;t timed this pull, got it from close to the toe end, still deep square has a lot of ground to cover and has to slide across to stop the boundary
angled in full at leg, he drives it down to long off
he gets away, swings hard at a short ball, edge flies over short extra cover and lands at vacant mid off
yorker, on off stump, patted back to the bowler
first ball Gambhir walks across and down the pitch, but cannot time the clip off the pad, in the air down to deep square
quicker offbreak nudged to square leg
looks to stretch forward, it is flighted fuller, he softly defends onto the pitch
goes back again to a length ball and punches to the sweeper
nicely stretching forward to nudge to square leg
goes back outside leg to a tossed up delivery angled in, rolls fine off pad
comes forward to a slowly tossed up offspinner and gets it behind square leg, Murali appeals for lbw, that wasn't a bad shout, probably too much angle with the turn
presses right forward to push towards covers for a single
lovely wrists, YK on fire, short, into the body, but not getting up too much, he swats it behind square even as he swivels, no chance for fine leg
powerful cut, widish from Vinay and YK's flashed it past backward point's dive
he's lifted his first ball over the bowler for four, pitched up, he plonks front foot and goes through with the swing, easy
dropped softly behind square on off for a quick single
Kallis has picked out sweeper cover, he was struggling to time them, comes out, backing away towards leg, and swings hard, straight into the hands of the fielder
well played in the end, goes back to a length ball and cuts from close to off, diving stop at backward point by AB
tossed up on middle, slogged hard, slogged cleanly to the deep midwicket boundary
comes down the track, tries to push to off, off the inner part of the bat to the bowler
swept from outside off, but straight to deep square
shortish and angled in, pulled to deep square leg
eases a tossed up ball to long on
length ball on off and middle, pushed down to long on
slices a pitched up delivery down to third man
beaten now as he flashes to a length ball outside off
he's eyeing the leg side, turns it from outside off to midwicket, falls short of Gayle tumbling to his right
tries to pull a short and wide one outside off, misses
good length just outside off, dabbed to third man

that hurried into the left-hander with the angle, he went back to drag a pull in the air over square leg, Gambhir has to dive in for the second, better throw would have had him in trouble, it was a wide one
spins in sharply from outside off, Kallis nudges it behind square, short fine leg throws it to the keeper, who breaks the stumps but the ball is out of his hand, Gambhir would have made it anyway
Gambhir flowing as always against spin, goes back and across and nudges off the pads to square leg
Gambhir bends the knee and heaves from outside off, and gets enough connection to hit it over mid on
tries to sweep one angled in full, misses, no-ball signalled, free hit coming up, that is a big no ball
comes down right away, tossed up delivery, he takes it on the full and puts it away through extra cover
this came in from outside off, he guides it to third man
tries to come down and go through the off side, can;t connect with a length ball close to off
chops a length ball down to third man
no stopping this, Kallis moves out and towards leg, creates space and lifts a length ball over the bowler
this time he times the straight drive well, but Henriques gets the right foot across in time even as he falls over
walks out now, tries to work it to leg, gets a leading edge to covers for a tight single
beaten again outside off with one angled slowly across
Kallis is let off, he was getting impatient, mishit a slog to midwicket, Kohli went for the non-striker's stumps, missed and there was no one backing up, Unadkat can;t even let out his frustration
slower one from Unadkat now, Kallis surprised, starts to go for the drive, then tries to run it fine in the end, misses
wider, Kallis goes harder at it, mishits the drive to mid off
pitched up, around off, driven to extra cover
waits a touch and runs a length ball wide of third man, Murali tries to stop the ball with his foot, slight fumble and they take two
shortish, outside off, attempted dab from Gambhir, and he's beaten
nice, on the pads again, and Gambhir picks it elegantly off middle and leg, and sends it racing in the air through midwicket
this time he connects with a very full one on the pads and sends it to fine leg
stifled appeal for lbw as Kallis misses the whip to leg and is hit on the pad
shortish and swinging away, lots of bounce, left alone
shot! Gambhir's come out and lofted this cleanly and powerfully over extra cover's jump
almost plays on a flail to a back of a length ball outside off, rolls past the keeper who is not able to stop it
short again, and now Gambhir is ready to crack it past cover
turned to square leg, again Gambhir is rather eager to take the run, not getting it

short again, Gambhir cannot time the cut, too much bounce, Kohli charges across from cover, Gambhir wants the single and is halfway down the pitch, Kallis sends his back, Gambhir had no chance had Kohli's throw hit, but the fielder was off balance and got rid of the ball too soon
banged in short as Gambhir comes out right away, he adjusts to push it to off
the Henriques move works for RCB, he strikes first over, short outside off,  Bisla on his toes to try and cut it, spoons it to point, it is dying in front of him, he tumbles to take it
short and into the body, hooked confidently to deep square
pushes a length ball softly from the crease, it rolls on the pitch towards leg, Henriques after it, Gambhir after the run, they collide, Gambhir makes it, and exchanges a cold stare with the bowler
angled in to off now, fullish and straightening, he eases it towards mid off
flashes at a pitched up outswinger widish outside off and is beaten
angled down the leg side on a good length
swinging away very full, around off, patted away softly
that will be that, he banishes a length ball high over long on to end with nine sixes
slanted too wide across the left-hander
short, Gayle swivels and pulls, again it appears he hasn;t timed it, but try telling the man at deep square leg that, he had no chance as it sailed over
slow length ball, tries to steer it to third man, misses
pitched up and disdainfully driven through the off side, but extra cover in the way
very full, Gayle makes some room, and eases it through the off side
good length ball straight and down the leg side
drills an overpitched one to wide long off
slow length ball sitting up, AB makes room and swats it over the straight boundary
walks outside off, Bhatia takes it away from the right hander slowly, AB beaten on the cut
slow and full, quietly pushed to covers for one
heaves at a full toss, thick edge runs down to third man
short, and he lets it go outside off
Gayle getting it done with, full toss outside off, and a slice takes it over backward point
no difference to Gayle, uses the angle into him to shovel it over wide long on, making some room outside leg to swing big, it is also a no ball
fullish length this time, and Gayle punishes it, slamming it over long off
nice work from Kallis, gets it around the blockhole first, and then gets the boot out to stop the hit from Gayle
low full toss hit to extra cover
beats him outside off with a straighter and quicker one that AB plays well inside the line of, he's had little clue about Narine this innings
sharp single, pushed off the front foot to cover and AB makes it comfortably
straight and quick, AB deep in the crease to push to long on
pushed to extra cover
misses as he flashes at an offbreak outside off
low full toss, point takes pace off the shot with a dive, Gayle charges back for the second and just makes it, better throw and he was gone
full, wide, way too wide outside off
in the blockhole outside off, even Gayle has to squeeze it to the bowler
slow bouncer, Gayle cannot get bat to it as he tries the help it fine
slow and full and wide, Gayle reaches out and stabs it to point
walks outside off, and hits a very full one down the ground
overpitched from round the stumps, powered wide of the sweeper, who does well to get around to it
tries to reverse paddle, but misses, appeal for lbw turned down
thick inside edge to the leg side as he gets forward to defend, and that is another fifty in the IPL for Chris Gayle, Chinnaswamy is generous is in the applause
tossed up, he comes forward and defends to point
pushes front foot forward, waits, and lets this offbreak pass by him outside off
worked through midwicket from outside off
outside edge, past slip, carrom ball moving away, AB had no clue about it
nice recovery from Balaji, slowish and full around the blockhole, Gayle swings and gets an inside edge onto boot
that has been carted into outer space, and has then been pulled down by gravity miles beyond deep midwicket, length around off, Gayle taking care of it
oops, he lost this one, very high full toss past the batsman, bounces close to the keeper
pushes an overpitched one to extra cover
dropped, touch chance, AB slapping a short ball high to the left of short extra cover, Tiwary goes leaping, but it goes down
bat in front of pad to ease a pitched up ball to long off
slower and full, he tries to reach for it, misses
AB's getting the width to murder them through extra cover, he's timed it too well this time, and the placement is wide enough of the sweeper
he is ready with a foreboding backlift, but this one is too far outside off, keepre fails to gather
short ball, there is a man at deep midwicket, but Gayle's pulled it flat and well out of the reach of that fielder
flayed down to sweeper cover
very low full toss, Gayle squeezes it down to long on
Balaji saves four with a sprawl to his right, AB connecting with the paddle this time
tries to sweep one angling far away outside off, misses it
third man is up, even if he was back, he would have struggled to stop this, Gayle has cut it so savagely backward of point
Balaji getting in some quiet slower ones in, AB walks out, he shortens the length, and he has to drop it onto the pitch
ending on off from a length, pushed to mid on again
pitched up on the stumps, pushed to mid on
Balaji's slower one does it, Kohli comes out and slices it to sweeper cover running in
around the blockhole, Gayle pats it back
short of a length, Gayle does not go after the width, guides it tamely to point
high full toss, Kohli swats it to off for a single
over fine leg now, Kohli doing everything to show RCB don't entirely depend on Gayle, shortish again, and he swivels to pull, edge flies over the boundary
outstanding timing, shortish and sitting up, Kohli;s banished that several rows over deep midwicket with a swift pull
hit hard down to long on
gentle length ball outside off, and Gayle has scythed that past the man at mid off, who had only a few feet to cover to his right, he still couldn't get to it
overpitched, and Kohli's sent it scorching along the ground to the deep extra cover rope, intent, full of intent
holds its line on off, good length, Kohli runs it to point
beaten by a slower one angled in and bouncing, dies in front of the keeper
width, lots of it, Gayle reaches across and drills it past point's dive, good work from the sweeper to stop it
slowish length ball going across, Gayle shoulders arms
pitched up on the stumps, eased down to long on
keeps strike with a single through the off side
offspinner bounces big on Kohli, but how well has he handled that, bends, delays the cut and hits the gap between short third man and backward point, lovely
overpitched on the pads, worked to deep midwicket
straightening outside off, pushed wide of cover
dabs an offbreak from off to short third
reaches out and hits a length ball to point
massive, six over cover, shifts further outside leg stump now, crouches and lifts an overpitched one over the infield, it lands comfortably over the rope, insane timing and power this man has
whack! good length, Gayle sends it soaring over wide long on, gets front foot a few inches outside leg and picks it from around off
good length and straightening, he opens the face and runs it down to third man
full, Kohli swipes, mid on is up, and he gets enough bat on it to lift it over the fielder
reaches out and pushes a pitched up ball to extra cover
Kohli gets moving, takes a step out and heaves a short of a length ball past midwicket
full and angled fast down the leg side, neat take by the keeper
tries to sweep an offbreak but is beaten as it moves away outside off
shortish and quick, Kohli goes for the pull, mishits it in the air down the ground to long on
works an offspinner to midwicket
tossed up fuller around off, he comes forward and runs it behind point
flatter, bounces as it spins away, punched to cover
tossed up offbreak, pitches on leg, spins across, blocked off the front foot
not hitting the gaps, Kohli, it's a maiden as he comes out and squeezes a full one to cover
full toss, but Kohli's turned this straight to midwicket, smiles sheepishly after that
guides a short of a length ball to point
he lost control of this swing, one hand coming off hand in the followthrough, beaten on the length ball outside off
across and behind the line to defend a back of a length ball
pushes a pitched up ball wide of mid on
Gayle has massacred this short ball for six over long on, it came quickly onto him, he didn;t look like he'd got much on the pull, all deception, it;s rocketed rows into the crowd
short, Kohli adjusts to open the face and runs it to third man
checks the push to a straightening full ball outside off, to covers
no problems with the edge this time, Agarwal trying to dab a shortish and wide one, healthy edge to the keeper
now this one is angled in and moves down leg
wow, that is a ripper, banged in short of a length, and takes off and swerves away, Agarwal's bat far away from it as he wafts
shortish and wide, swinging away a tad, Agarwal goes after it and is beaten
worked to deep square leg off the pad
loud appeal from Kallis for caught behind, Agarwal going for an awkward pull, replays show it hit the thigh pad before going low to the keeper, was there a bottom edge before that, not sure
pitched up on the stumps, he is across in the crease to block
length on the pads, calmly turned through square leg
stays on the crease and runs a length ball outside off to third man
full, wide, Agarwal reaches for it, and slices it over backward point
nice, making him play around off, and leaving him with the angle, very close to the outside edge, good bounce too
skips down the pitch and looks to deposit the length ball over mid on, misses
short, Gayle swivels and pulls it hard, in the air over forward square leg
makes him play, he pushes a good length ball towards mid off
going across him with the angle again, slightly shorter, and he shoulders arms
gets across and pushes a length ball angled across in front of cover, wants the single, has to get back quickly
